## When to use

Use when previewing generated-block-only instruction or catalog updates that require AP-X approval.

## Workflow

Edit only the marked generated block, show preview diff, and obtain AP-X before writing instruction files.

## Checks

Confirm evidence paths, approval policy, and surface fallback before claiming completion.

## Output

Return the procedure contract fields inside Handoff v1 without inventing unavailable tooling.
